settings.label: Enabled
settings.description:
Shows YouTube on the main menu
Needs yt-dlp, on the OSD/OS image already; an account is optional (SIGN IN, below)

settings.label: Sign In
settings.description:
Opens Google's sign-in page full screen, to sign in with a keyboard: YouTube then searches and plays as that account, with fewer bot checks
YouTube can block an account used through yt-dlp: sign in with a spare one
Needs Chromium, or Google Chrome on a Mac

settings.label: Subscriptions
settings.description:
Your channels, a line each: a channel's id (UC and 22 more), or its link with /channel/ in it
youtube_subscriptions.txt in the data folder adds its own

settings.label: Playlists
settings.description:
Your playlists, a line each: a playlist's link or its id, with a name and | before it if you like
youtube_playlists.txt in the data folder adds its own

settings.label: Subtitles
settings.description:
Whether a video's subtitles show as it starts
[OFF] Not shown
[ON] A video's own subtitles, in Subtitle Language where it has them
[ON + AUTO CAPTIONS] Also YouTube's automatic captions

settings.label: Subtitle Language
settings.description:
The language subtitles are shown in, where a video has several
[ANY] Whichever the video has; with automatic captions, those in its own language

settings.label: Audio Language
settings.description:
The audio track of a video that has several
[ORIGINAL] The one it was made in

settings.label: Resume Playback
settings.description:
Where a video stopped part-way starts again
[ASK] Asks: from where it stopped, or from the beginning
[ALWAYS] From where it stopped
[NEVER] From the beginning

settings.label: Scaling
settings.description:
How a 16:9 picture fills the 4:3 screen in this module
[DEFAULT] As Settings' Scaling says

settings.label: Advanced
settings.description: Picture and speed: the most a video plays at, its codec and frame rate, and how fast it plays

settings.label: Max Resolution
settings.description:
The most a video plays at; lower where it has nothing this high
[480P] Right for a CRT and a Pi  [1440P] [2160P] Need Video Codec ANY: YouTube has H.264 only up to 1080p

settings.label: Video Codec
settings.description: [H.264] What a Pi decodes in hardware, wherever YouTube has it  [ANY] Whatever looks best, often VP9 or AV1, decoded in software

settings.label: Max Frame Rate
settings.description: [30] 30 fps where a video also has 60: lighter on a Pi

settings.label: Delete Watch Later
settings.description: Empties Watch Later, the videos kept on this player to watch later

settings.label: Delete Recently Watched
settings.description: Empties Recently Watched, and forgets where each video was stopped

settings.label: Sign Out
settings.description: Forgets the YouTube sign-in on this player
